row.header: Notice OP00118817, P156634, Kenya, sanitation, Request for Expression of Interest
row.text: Specifically, the successful candidate shall have the following qualifications: A BSc. degree in Civil Engineering or equivalent. A Master’s degree will be an added advantage. At least 15 years relevant experience, which should include providing technical support to water sector institutions. Registered with a recognized and relevant professional engineering body. Working experience on similar projects in Kenya. Experience in World Bank or other major bilateral donor programmes, County Government or National Governments will be an advantage. Duration and Commencement of the Consultancy. This is a full-time post requiring physical presence in Kenya up to project closure (October 2022). However, the Project Engineer shall be engaged on a one-year renewable contract subject to satisfactory performance and continuation of the project.
